title: Introduction to Biology Unit Test
subject: biology
description: Sample summative exam for Introduction to Biology.
instructions: Choose the best answer for each question.

questions.question: Which branch of biology studies animals?
questions.explanation: Zoology is the branch of biology concerned with animals.

questions.question: Which sequence best represents a simple scientific method?
questions.explanation: Scientific investigation usually begins with a question, followed by a hypothesis, testing, and conclusion.

questions.question: Which activity is an example of applying biology in agriculture?
questions.explanation: Biological knowledge helps improve crops, livestock, soil health, and pest control.

questions.question: What should students do first when an accident occurs in the laboratory?

options.C: Report it to the teacher immediately

questions.explanation: Laboratory accidents must be reported immediately so the correct safety response can be taken.

questions.question: Which item protects the eyes during laboratory work?
questions.explanation: Safety goggles protect the eyes from splashes, fumes, and flying particles.

questions.question: Which statement about living things is correct?

options.A: All living things are made of cells
options.C: Living things do not respond to changes

questions.explanation: Cells are the basic structural and functional units of living organisms.
